name: Know Yourself
tagline: Turns your own company records into one answer everyone can quote
description: Point it at the places your business already keeps its numbers and history, and it becomes the thing people ask first. Back comes a quick picture of where things stand, a single settled answer to questions that keep coming round, and your own position laid beside a competitor's when you need the gap stated plainly.
